subject: LOWEST-ALGEBRAIC function
notes: Both halves of r1 witnessed on LOWEST-ALGEBRAIC itself: category (PIC X(5), class alphanumeric per 8.5.2.1 Table 2) and the function exclusion (LENGTH = integer per 15.50.1, ABS over a non-integer numeric = numeric per 15.7.1, plus a UDF result) - the exclusion needed because 8.5.2.12 items 6/7 put functions in category numeric. The paired positive golden carries the ADMIT side, so a blanket refusal cannot pass both. Previously pinned only for the HIGHEST twin (negative/algebraic-udf-argument, 15.43.3 r1). || editions 2002,2014,2023 (kb/Work PB3173, S0b; DESIGN-conformance-suite.md §6 step 0): the LOWEST-ALGEBRAIC function exists from 2002 (IntrinsicCatalog.cs, the COBOL1502 edition window).
